Type: running track kids play rug
Use: playing, racing toy cars and sitting on the floor; kids room, playroom, nursery
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: soft low pile with a printed pattern
Colors: bright tomato red, white
Shape: rectangle printed like a running track with six numbered lanes, white lane lines and curved start marks, flat
Feel: playful, sporty, energetic
Goes with: white or light wood kids furniture, red and primary accents; children's rooms and playrooms

product.name: SPRINGA
